verdict.rationale: Brex can be driven headlessly through its REST APIs (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments) using static user tokens passed in request headers. It also offers webhook registration and integration recipes for Pipedream, Zapier and Workato, so scripted automation is clearly possible. However, there is no evidence of a CLI or CI-specific tooling, tokens are created manually in the dashboard, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 at every machine-readable path. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration guidance, programmatic or service-account credential provisioning, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
